extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary article text and figures; no direct membrane-disruption assay was found in local XML/PDF/supplement materials.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper treats the MIC cation-dependence across analogues as consistent with a shared membrane-lytic mechanism, but this is an inferred mechanism context rather than a direct permeabilization assay in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization or killing-mechanism assay was locally present; do not promote this to direct_mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra show random coil in aqueous buffer and alpha-helical secondary structure in TFE/water membrane-mimetic conditions for selected peptides, supporting structural context for AMP activity without proving a direct membrane mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD spectra are structural context only and are not a direct antimicrobial mechanism assay.
